scope: MedAnon ceff209, full detectors (rules+spaCy/Presidio+BERT+OpenMed), --offline. 'train140' = the 140 Bosch training encounters; synthetic probes = attack/handoff/synthetic_regressions (invented text).
severity_scale: high = ~6 bits (one-year cohort) or more per record; medium = a few bits or clinical content lost; low = provenance/reporting
not_measured: Top-1/Top-5 linkage, linkage success, coverage, precision, wrong attributions and absent-target false matches: this attacker estimates population uniqueness and recovers masked values; it has no auxiliary identity database or synthetic population. Use the Splink attacker for those.

vulnerabilities.title: Adult birth year survives age_bands when no adult age is stated in the record
vulnerabilities.severity: high per instance; prevalence 0/140 observed under age_bands
vulnerabilities.auxiliary_information: Visit year (encounter year is public for this dataset or inferable) and a population table of birth cohorts. No auxiliary identity database needed.
vulnerabilities.mechanism: A birth year is a one-year birth cohort (~6.3 bits, the same as an exact age). With the visit year it gives the exact age back, which is exactly what age_bands exists to prevent. configs/age_bands.yaml says the adult birth year is removed; it is only removed when an adult AGE is also detected in the record.

frequency.note: Records whose anonymized text shows a 4-/2-digit year next to DOB/born/[DOB]. Under age_bands all 4 remaining hits (D2N099, D2N100, D2N183, D2N185) are children (kept by design): adult birth-year residue is 0/140. In these transcripts the age is always stated next to the DOB, so the bug only triggers on records without a stated age.

synthetic_repro.probe: SYN-DOB-01 (no age stated) vs SYN-DOB-02 (52-year-old stated)

actual_output_age_bands.SYN-DOB-01:
[doctor] can you confirm your date of birth ?
[patient] [DOB] 1971 .
[doctor] thanks . and your husband ?
[patient] he was born in '68 .
---NOTE---
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient (DOB [DOB] 71) presents for hypertension follow-up.
actual_output_age_bands.SYN-DOB-02:
[doctor] so this is a [50-59]-year-old male . date of birth is [DOB] ?
[patient] yes .
---NOTE---
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
The patient is a [50-59]-year-old male, DOB [DOB], here for hypertension.

vulnerabilities.expected_behavior: Under age_bands, '[DOB]' with no year whenever reference_year - birth_year >= 18, independent of whether an age was detected; two-digit years ('71', 03/03/71) resolved to 19xx/20xx first. Paediatric birth years (age < 18) kept.
vulnerabilities.likely_component: src/medanon/transform.py (DOB policy: adult decision coupled to detected AGE); DOB 2-digit year parsing
vulnerabilities.clinical_consequence_of_fix: None for adults (the age band carries the clinical information). Keep paediatric years.
regression_tests: SYN-DOB-01 privacy assertions must pass under age_bands
a child ('date of birth june 2nd 2019') keeps its year under age_bands
vulnerabilities.recommendation: fix before submission if cheap (it silently defeats age_bands); rank after V3 and V2

vulnerabilities.title: Clinical words masked as identifiers (over-redaction)
vulnerabilities.auxiliary_information: n/a (utility loss, not a privacy leak)
vulnerabilities.mechanism: NER labels exam/anatomy words, symptoms, OTC products and order words as PERSON/LOCATION/EMPLOYER/ORGANIZATION/OCCUPATION: 'lungs'->[PERSON], 'neurovascular'->[LOCATION], 'barky cough'->[EMPLOYER], 'Biofreeze'/'referral'->[ORGANIZATION], 'heart doctor'/'kidney doctors'->[OCCUPATION]. The masked words are not identifying, so masking them only loses clinical content (exam findings, croup symptom).

synthetic_repro.probes: SYN-OVER-01/03 reproduce (Biofreeze in 'use some X on the neck'; 'neurovascular's intact'; 'Neurovascular status intact'); SYN-OVER-02/04 do NOT reproduce (lungs, barky cough, referral are context-dependent: seen only in real transcripts)

actual_output_age_bands.SYN-OVER-03:
[doctor] your grips are equal . [LOCATION]'s intact . try some icy hot or biofreeze on it .
[patient] okay .
---NOTE---
PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Grips equal. [LOCATION] status intact.

PLAN
Topical Icy Hot or Biofreeze.

vulnerabilities.expected_behavior: Clinical vocabulary is never a PERSON/LOCATION/ORGANIZATION/EMPLOYER/OCCUPATION span.
vulnerabilities.likely_component: post-NER filter (medical.py / lexicon guard) applied to ML-detector spans (BERT/OpenMed label maps)
vulnerabilities.clinical_consequence_of_fix: Positive: restores exam findings and symptoms. Risk: a real name that is also an anatomy word; keep names in name position ('okay frank , your lungs...').
regression_tests: attack.audit_masks on a labelled set: clinical_term blocks -> 0
vulnerabilities.recommendation: fix before submission (protects Bosch medical-concept recall)

vulnerabilities.title: Exact adult age retained under the default policy
vulnerabilities.severity: high under default, resolved by age_bands
vulnerabilities.mechanism: Exact age = one-year cohort, ~6.3 bits: the largest single quasi-identifier in all 8 records attacked with the LLM (both runs). A 10-year band costs ~3 bits.
vulnerabilities.clinical_consequence_of_fix: Decade bands lose age-specific thresholds (screening 45 vs 50, dosing); paediatric ages exact.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: ship age_bands.yaml (then V1 becomes the main age leak)

vulnerabilities.title: Named landmark next to a masked place gives the place back
vulnerabilities.auxiliary_information: General world knowledge (an LLM): 'mount baker' -> Washington.
vulnerabilities.mechanism: The state and a lodge are masked but 'Mount Hood' / 'Mount Baker' stays; the LLM recovered the masked state with high confidence (eval D2N001, older MedAnon build).

frequency.llm_recovery: 1 of 1 recoverable masked place recovered (eval D2N001, old build); 1/7 scorable guesses overall
frequency.train140_landmark_within_120_chars_of_ma: 0/140 (default; heuristic scan, one false positive excluded)

vulnerabilities.expected_behavior: Named natural landmarks (Mount/Mt X, Lake X, X National Park, X River) masked as [LOCATION], at least in sentences that already contain a masked place.
vulnerabilities.likely_component: LOCATION detection (spaCy FAC/LOC labels or a landmark rule)
vulnerabilities.clinical_consequence_of_fix: None expected; keep eponyms and scores ('Lake Louise score') as negative tests.
regression_tests: negative: 'mount the brace', 'lake louise score' unchanged
vulnerabilities.recommendation: fix if time allows (low prevalence); otherwise document

vulnerabilities.title: Bare numeric answer to 'how old are you?' kept
vulnerabilities.mechanism: Lead L1 from the other attacker. '[doctor] how old are you now ? [patient] 54 .' keeps 54 under every policy.
vulnerabilities.expected_behavior: A bare number in the reply to an age question about the patient is treated as AGE.
vulnerabilities.clinical_consequence_of_fix: None (questions about relatives' ages must not trigger: 'how old was your mother' negative test).
regression_tests: negative: 'how old was your mother ? mom was 40' is about a relative (policy choice)
vulnerabilities.recommendation: cheap; fix if V1/V2 are done

leads_and_artifacts.lead: Over-redaction of clinically important values and dates
leads_and_artifacts.result: partly intended policy: LAB_VALUE generalize turns 'ejection fraction 45%' into '[40-50]%' and 'A1c 8.2' into '[8-9]' (SYN-KEEP-01). Medications, doses and relative chronology are kept. My attacker never prices lab values, so it has no evidence for or against lab generalization; note EF [40-50] straddles the HFrEF (<=40) / HFmrEF boundary.

leads_and_artifacts.lead: Reproducibility: manifest code_sha256 differs between machines for the same commit
